encodings.note: Read the requested list of MSRs, and store the read values to memory.

exceptions.when: The RDMSRLIST instruction is not recognized in protected mode.
The RDMSRLIST instruction is not recognized in real-address mode.
The RDMSRLIST instruction is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
The RDMSRLIST instruction is not recognized in compatibility mode.

If the current privilege level is not 0. If RSI [2:0] 0, RDI [2:0] 0, or bits 63:32 of an MSR-address table entry are not all zero. If an execution of RDMSR from a specified MSR would generate a general protection exception #GP(0). If the memory address is in a non-canonical form. #PF(fault-code) If a page fault occurs.
If the LOCK prefix is used. If CPUID.07H.01H:EAX.MSRLIST[27] = 0.
